author: DaDanielHThorn
quote: Rockstar leaned way too hard into Red Dead Redemption 2’s slow-burn realism, and it completely kills the arcade fun that made Grand Theft Auto famous in the first place. Between fixing leaky roofs, managing daily chores, babysitting fragile cars that need constant expensive repairs, and dealing with an overly fussy police "Heat" system, the game feels more like a second job than an escape. The opening hours drag on forever before you even get to do anything exciting, and by the time the map finally opens up, I am already exhausted by all the tedious survival mechanics getting in the way of actual chaos.
